picks.name: Sam Binga & Addison Groove
picks.source_note: Both already in your library (Bass/Bar playlists).
picks.bio: Two artists already in your library, teaming up for the first time. "BAGS INC." (July 10, 2026, Pineapple Records) is their debut collaborative album -- 12 tracks born from a 72-hour session with vintage drum machines, filtering Chicago house, Detroit jit, juke and electro through a UK bass lens.
picks.why_listen: A raw, high-tempo (140-150bpm) tribute to Midwest club music from two artists you already play separately -- built for peak-time energy with a UK soundsystem edge.

picks.name: Olof Dreijer (feat. MaMan, Pearson Sound remix)
picks.source_note: New label discovery: DH2 (Dirty Hit's electronic imprint). Similar ambient/electronic territory to your Brian d'Souza and Bergsonist picks.
picks.bio: One half of The Knife, now solo. "Echoed Dafnino (ft. MaMan) (Pearson Sound Remix)" (August 19, 2026) reworks a cut from his debut solo album "Loud Bloom" into a more clubbable, rhythm-forward reimagining.
picks.why_listen: A left-field, texturally rich remix from an artist with serious pedigree -- Pearson Sound's rework gives it just enough club utility for a more adventurous stretch of a set.
